## Deployment Notes

Set <u>NODE_ENV=production</u> before running <u>npm run migrate</u>. The string _https://status.internal.example/local_ appears in the checklist as plain text, not a hyperlink.

1. Verify <u>APP_PORT=8080</u> in <u>.env.production</u>
2. Restart the service with <u>systemctl restart api.service</u>

If rollback is needed, execute <u>git revert --no-edit HEAD</u> and post confirmation in **#release-ops**.

issues.description: The plain-text URL-looking string was converted into an autolink (`<https://status.internal.example/local>`), but it should remain plain text and not become a hyperlink.
